_doc: The MCP tool budget: the only place its limits live (S31 R21; rules in docs/mcp/conventions.md).
A tool's size is len(name) + len(description) + len(compact JSON of its listed inputSchema), in characters.
default_listing: the core group, which every session lists. group_default: each other group unless groups
has an entry for it. tool_default: each tool unless exceptions has an entry (a higher limit for a tool that
predates the rule, or a lower cap a spec set). A spec that moves a tool into core records it in core_trades
with what core gave up for it, and the default listing must still fit.
guide: the agent guide (initialize.instructions = jasper://guide), in UTF-8 bytes: the whole text with its
generated tool groups section, and each '## ' section (the text before the first one counts as a section);
sections names a section's own limit. headroom_bytes: the whole text must stay that far under bytes, room
for the tool groups and digest lines later specs add. Area detail goes to docs/mcp/guide/<area>.md, never
into a raised limit or a smaller headroom. client_cut: the sections a client that keeps only the first chars
characters must still get whole (UTF-16 code units, as JavaScript counts), and the pointer the intro must carry.

client_cut.reason: Claude Code keeps the first 4096 characters of server instructions (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH default, agent-authoring)

diagnostics.spec: S06 (3 tools), S07 (4), S09 (4) and S28 (5) share it; the default 15,000 characters still apply

device.spec: S56 (get_device_info and set_device_simulation within 1,500 characters; the tier table goes through set_project_settings)

scripting.spec: S23's 12 (hot reload, script status and settings, editor menus, expressions, the graph tools) and upstream's user_settings (PlayerPrefs, the scripts' saved data: no group fits it better; SYNC#4)

editor_ux.spec: S24's 4 tools, BF1's find_ui_item, S25's 8 (search, commands, shortcuts, layouts, labels, saved searches, bookmarks), S26's 5 Scene view tools (pick_at, bookmarks, layout, measures, filters), upstream's place_with_physics and S08's get_inspector_layout (the Inspector's drawn rows; it reads the editor UI as find_ui_item does, so it stays in this group), and SYNC#4's configure_game_view (upstream ui-scaling-text and safe-area made the Game view toolbar's editor preferences a tool; out of core so the default listing fits, its options in jasper://docs/ui)

terrain.spec: The one limit for T1-T5 (programme decision D17, T1 R74), lowered to the measured total plus 5 % when T4 lands: sculpt_terrain, set_terrain_maps, sample_terrain, T1's edit_terrain, visualize_terrain and export_terrain_heightmap, T2's generate_terrain and preview_noise_graph, T4's edit_terrain_world, and agent-authoring's edit_terrain_details
